notes: OBSERVED: DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 records manual compaction as one same-session working bracket. The 2026-09-20 recording has one durable start, summary, and end, then completes the continuation and ready settle window without tool calls.

text: The post-marker DSH session appears in ready after TUI launch
The repeated-token priming prompt drives the session from ready to working
The completed priming turn returns the same session to ready with enough history for a useful compact summary
The standalone compaction/start marker drives the same ready session to working before the auxiliary summarizer yields
Compaction/end returns the same session to ready after the checkpoint commits, with no mid-compaction waiting state
The post-compaction prompt drives the same continued session from ready to working
The post-compaction turn completes and returns the same session to ready
The continued session stays ready after the final turn until driver teardown
